div.div: وَذَحٌ The dung and urine that have clung to the wool of sheep, (K,) or to their tails and the inner sides of the roots of their thighs (أَرْفَاغها), and dry [thereon]: (S:) or the filth that clings to the rump, or buttocks, of the ram: (Th:) n. un. with ة: pl. وُذْحٌ; like بُدْنٌ, (S, K,) pl. of بَدَنَةٌ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
